name: B.Ed (General)
eligibility: Bachelor's / Master's Degree with minimum 50% marks (47.5% for SC/ST)
affiliation: Affiliated to MDU, Rohtak & Recognized by NCTE
description: Bachelor of Education (General) prepares aspiring educators with foundational pedagogical knowledge, classroom methodologies, educational psychology, curriculum planning, and modern ICT-enabled teaching skills for secondary and senior secondary schools.
highlights: NCTE Recognized Teacher Training Program
Affiliated to Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak
School Internship & Teaching Practicum in Recognized Schools
Comprehensive Pedagogical & ICT-Enabled Classrooms
Well-Equipped Educational Psychology and Science Labs
careerOpportunities: Secondary & Senior Secondary School Teacher (TGT / PGT)
Curriculum Developer & Instructional Designer
Academic Coordinator & School Administrator
Educational Consultant & Content Developer
Eligible for CTET, HTET, and State Teacher Eligibility Tests
curriculumHighlights: Pedagogy of School Subjects (Sciences, Maths, Social Science, Languages)
Critical Understanding of ICT in Education
admissionProcess: Admissions are conducted through centralized MDU Rohtak online counseling based on merit in the qualifying graduation / post-graduation examination.

name: BEd (Special Education)-SLD
eligibility: Bachelor's / Master's Degree with minimum 50% marks from a recognized university
affiliation: Affiliated to MDU, Rohtak & Recognized by RCI
description: Bachelor of Education in Special Education with specialization in Specific Learning Disabilities (SLD), equipping educators with specialized diagnostic assessment, remedial education, and inclusive teaching strategies for children with dyslexia, dysgraphia, and dyscalculia.
highlights: Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) Recognized
Specialized in Specific Learning Disabilities (SLD / Dyslexia)
Clinical Diagnosis, Screening & Remedial Learning Modules
Inclusive School Training & Rehabilitation Centers Attachment
Direct Eligibility for RCI Professional CRR Registration
careerOpportunities: Special Educator in Inclusive & Mainstream Schools
Remedial Educator in Child Guidance Clinics
Specialized Tutor for Children with Dyslexia & Learning Challenges
Resource Teacher under Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
Registered Rehabilitation Practitioner under RCI (CRR Number)
curriculumHighlights: Curriculum Designing, Adaptation & Accommodations for SLD
Remedial Teaching Methodologies for Reading, Writing & Math
admissionProcess: Admissions are conducted through university counseling based on graduation merit following Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) and MDU Rohtak norms.

name: M.Ed (Special Education)-SLD
eligibility: B.Ed. Special Education (SLD) or B.Ed. with Diploma in Special Education (min 50% marks)
affiliation: Affiliated to MDU, Rohtak & Recognized by RCI
description: Master of Education in Special Education focusing on Specific Learning Disabilities (SLD), training advanced special educators, researchers, teacher-educators, policy implementers, and institutional supervisors in the field of inclusive education.
highlights: Advanced Post-Graduate Program Recognized by RCI
Advanced Diagnostic Assessment & Psycho-Educational Research
Prepares Teacher Educators, Curriculum Developers & Supervisors
Master's Dissertation, Advanced Practicum & Clinical Internship
Direct Pathway to Doctoral (Ph.D.) Research in Education
careerOpportunities: Assistant Professor / Teacher Educator in Colleges of Education
Senior Special Education Consultant & Institutional Supervisor
Curriculum & Policy Specialist in State / National Educational Boards
Head of Inclusive Education Departments in Premier Institutions
Educational Researcher & Clinical Assessment Director
curriculumHighlights: Advanced Educational Psychology & Neurobiology of Learning
Research Methodology & Applied Statistics in Special Education
Advanced Diagnostic Testing & Clinical Interventions in SLD
Internship in Teacher Training Colleges & Special Centers
admissionProcess: Admissions are processed through university counseling based on merit in qualifying B.Ed Special Education examination.

name: P.G.D.R.P(Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabiliation Psychology)
eligibility: Master's Degree in Psychology (Regular) with minimum 55% aggregate marks from a recognized university
affiliation: Recognized by Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI)
description: Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology prepares trained rehabilitation psychologists and counselors to assess, support, and rehabilitate individuals with developmental, neurocognitive, sensory, and psychological challenges.
highlights: RCI Approved Clinical Rehabilitation Psychology Program
Qualifies Candidates as Registered Rehabilitation Counselors / Psychologists
Neurodevelopmental, Cognitive & Behavioral Intervention Training
Hospital & Clinical Rehabilitation Center Postings
300+ Supervised Clinical Internship Hours
careerOpportunities: Registered Rehabilitation Psychologist (CRR Holder)
Clinical Counselor in Multi-Specialty Hospitals & Rehabilitation Centers
Child & Adolescent Neuropsychological Assessor
Consultant in NGOs, Social Welfare Departments & De-addiction Units
Private Clinical Practice & Rehabilitation Consultation
curriculumHighlights: Biological Bases of Behavior & Clinical Psychopathology
Supervised Clinical Case Work & Diagnostic Reporting
admissionProcess: Admissions are administered based on post-graduate psychology merit and counseling in accordance with RCI statutory guidelines.

name: DHLS(Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech)
eligibility: 10+2 / Higher Secondary with PCM / PCB and Above
affiliation: Recognized by Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI)
description: Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS) provides comprehensive training in human vocal apparatus, soundwave acoustics, clinical audiology, hearing evaluation, and speech therapy rehabilitation.
highlights: RCI Recognized 1-Year Regular Offline Diploma
Central Admission via NBER-RCI Portal (30 Intake Seats)
Sound-Treated Audiology Instrumentation & Diagnostic Lab
Clinical Speech-Language Pathology & Indian Sign Language
Comprehensive Hospital & Clinical Field Training
careerOpportunities: Audiometric Assistant in ENT Hospitals & Diagnostic Clinics
Speech-Language Therapy Assistant in Rehabilitation Facilities
Hearing Aid Dispensing & Fitting Specialist
Community Hearing Healthcare & Screening Officer
Communication Instructor in Schools for the Hearing Impaired
curriculumHighlights: Anatomy & Physiology of Speech and Hearing Organs
Indian Sign Language (ISL) Grammar & Manual Alphabet
Supervised Audiometric & Speech Therapy Clinical Postings
admissionProcess: Central registration on the NBER-RCI online portal during admissions cycle, followed by institutional document verification and seat confirmation.
